We are not a catalogue. We are a trading partner that understands what professional food businesses need.

01

02
HoReCa and QSR specialists

03

Every product we supply is selected to meet the standards of professional kitchens. We do not compromise on quality to compete on price.

How it works

Simple from first enquiry to delivery

We have made the process straightforward, so you can focus on running your operation.

01
Get in touch

Reach out by phone, WhatsApp, or the enquiry form. Tell us what you need and the volumes you are working with.

02

Built on expertise.
Driven by purpose.

Esskay General Trading LLC was founded in 2008 with a clear purpose: to bring reliable, quality-led F&B supply to the Middle East's growing hospitality and foodservice sector. Drawing on a background in retail and FMCG, Esskay was built into a trusted trading partner for operators across the UAE.

What gives Esskay its edge is the foundation it was built on. The business is rooted in a co-founder's decades-long career at the heart of the region's F&B industry, including senior experience at one of the UAE's most respected food trading companies. That depth of knowledge, built over 50 years of combined regional experience, shapes how Esskay sources, trades, and serves its clients.

The founder is an active member of the Indian business community in the UAE, and brings both commercial rigour and a genuine care for the people and businesses Esskay works with.
